snippet.title: Catana: Red Flowers | Announcement Trailer | Meta Quest & PlayStation VR2
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now 👉

Meta: https://www.meta.com/experiences/8996571250452624/ 
PS VR2: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014711/ 

Step into the paws of a nimble ninja cat! Dash through enemies, deflect bullets, and master the katana in fast, fun VR combat.

Between battles, unwind in your cozy garden—sharpen your blade, play with Grandpa Kenji, or just be a silly cat. 

Join our Discord server to discuss and learn more about the game 👉 https://discord.com/invite/hWPT2jhzt2
